text:
ops-bot: 🔔 ALERT: pool=vstg-usw1 admission_control_ratio > 0.8 for 5m (alertid: pool-admit-90)
maya: seeing huge backlog on the hosted dispatcher panel, qlen jumped to ~200
leo: confirmed, influx of 1-2s short-running requests spiking concurrency — KV cache hits down
sam: any obvious deploys around the time? I didn't see a platform deploy in the window
anya: deploy-bot shows a model rollout at 11:58 but it was a canary to a tiny subset, unlikely to cause full-pool saturation
maya: posting the alert query we use:
```
max_over_time(admission_control_ratio{pool="vstg-usw1"}[5m]) > 0.8
```
maya: and a short log excerpt from the dispatcher:
```
[2026-03-15T12:02:21Z] pool=vstg-usw1 qlen=213 inflight=96 admission=0.92 model=redwood-lite v=1.3.2
[2026-03-15T12:03:05Z] pool=vstg-usw1 enqueue_latency_p95=450ms cache_hit_rate=0.12
```
leo: looks like a workload shift: many small chat requests with long-context tokens causing repeated KV thrash
oncall-sre: paging eng-sre on-call @here, this is impacting latency SLOs for hosted-tier customers
sam: quick mitigation options:
- temporarily open burst capacity for vstg-usw1 (allow extra 10 GPUs from spare pool)
- enable fallback routing to vstg-usw2 for non-sensitive traffic
- tighten admission thresholds for free-tier clients
anya: cost note — opening burst pool will add ~2.5k/hr if sustained, but should stop 5xx cascade
maya: can we do a short routing rule: route requests with model=redwood-lite and user_tier=free to vstg-usw2? low-risk
leo: I can flip a route rule, but need approval to change cross-region routing. latency to some users will increase ~30-50ms
oncall-sre: go ahead with routing to vstg-usw2 for non-enterprise clients, run for 15m and monitor
maya: done — created route `route/overflow/vstg-usw1->vstg-usw2` with predicate `(user_tier!="enterprise") && model=="redwood-lite"`
maya: enabling now...
ops-bot: ROUTE_CHANGE: overflow route enabled by maya at 12:06 UTC
leo: within 2 minutes qlen down to 80, inflight steady at 52, admission 0.55 :thumbsup:
sam: good. follow-ups:
- add a short-term dashboard panel for `admission_control_ratio by pool` with 1m granularity
- run a short traffic replay job to simulate the small-chat pattern and validate eviction behavior
anya: created a ticket: INFRA-4721 "Investigate KV cache thrash + routing policy for vstg-usw1" and linked this thread
oncall-sre: leaving note for postmortem if this repeats — consider making overflow route auto-enable when admit>0.75 for 3m
maya: agreed. also suggest we add an alert that correlates `cache_hit_rate < 0.2` with admission spikes
leo: I'll start a short runbook draft for eng-sre oncall with these mitigations
maya: thanks all, keeping watch for 15m window
ops-bot: ALERT RESOLVED: pool=vstg-usw1 admission_control_ratio returned below 0.6 at 12:11 UTC (duration 9m)
